events.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
events.summary: Hey everyone!Thank you for following the game! I wanted to share a quick update about Steam Deck support.My plans for Open Land include full Steam Deck support at release. I recently added gamepad support to the demo, which means you should already be able to play it on Steam Deck.If you have a Steamdeck, please let me know if you encounter any issues!You can join the Discord if you want to give me direct feedback here: https://discord.gg/Qy7neM9ggXThanks again! More news is coming soon :)-Ralph

events.title: Open Land Demo Update: New Robots, Controller Support, More Content

events.title: Open Land Demo is now live!
events.summary: Hey everyone! After a lot of work, the free demo for Open Land is now available on Steam. Jump in, transform a wasteland back into a thriving ecosystem with your robots, and let me know what you think in the comments. Your feedback means a lot at this stage!-Ralph

events.title: Open Land Playtest is live!
events.summary: The public playtest is available now and will run for the whole week. Feel free to jump in and let me know what you think :)
